no zones are left without an event; the request can be retried.

post.summary: Validate a scanned QR at the entrance (CU-11)
post.description:
**Role:** STAFF, and only for events the caller is assigned to (checked with CatalogService
`GET /internal/events/{eventId}/staff/{userId}`). On success the ticket becomes USED in
one atomic update (`UPDATE ... WHERE status = 'VALID'`), so two gates cannot both accept it.

Order of checks: signature -> staff assignment -> ticket belongs to `eventId` -> status.

Results: 200 `ACCESS_GRANTED` (green screen). Red screens: 422 `INVALID_SIGNATURE`,
403 `NOT_ASSIGNED`, 422 `WRONG_EVENT`, 409 `ALREADY_USED`, 409 `TICKET_CANCELLED`.
